title: For IPv4 subnets, list the subnet name along with the DNS nameserver order
question: For IPv4 subnets, list the subnet name along with the DNS nameserver order range, order variance, average DNS order, and DNS order variance, but only for subnets where the order variance is more than 75% of the DNS order variance. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.name, d.`order`
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
),
agg AS (
  SELECT id, name,
         MAX(`order`) - MIN(`order`) AS order_range,
         AVG(`order`) AS avg_dns_order,
         COUNT(`order`) AS cnt,
         SUM(POW(`order` - AVG(`order`), 2)) AS ss
  FROM base
  GROUP BY id, name
)
SELECT name,
       order_range,
       ss / cnt AS order_variance,
       avg_dns_order,
       ss / (cnt - 1) AS dns_order_variance
FROM agg
WHERE ss / cnt > 0.75 * (ss / (cnt - 1));
